question: Which further plants and substances complete the enumerated set of ritual materials?
inference: The verse extends the preceding list by adding piśāca plants, mṛdaṅgī, bhāryāṅgī, and garuḍa.
uncertainties: The exact ritual function of each listed item is not stated in this verse
The grammatical relation of the list to the preceding verse remains implicit
plain_english: Piśāca plants, and mṛdaṅgī, and bhāryāṅgī, and garuḍa likewise.
